axis: plain fact of inexperience → fond naming of a gentle, harmless soul

members.tone: Fond and protective, making sweetness and mildness the whole of the person; beside *lamb* it carries no picture, only affection.
Tender in the same way as *dear* but with the creature behind it, so the gentleness comes with defencelessness attached.
Names the absence itself rather than cooing over the person, so the warmth of *dear* gives way to something closer to unguardedness.
States a plain fact about a person's experience and attaches no fondness or reproach to it.
